description: This file defines the 'WithThingId' interface, which provides methods related to getting the identifier of a 'Thing' entity, including a deprecated method and a new preferred method.

classes.name: WithThingId
classes.description: An interface providing methods to access the identifier of a 'Thing' entity, including a deprecated string representation method and the current typed method.

methods.name: getThingId
methods.description: Returns the thing's identifier as a string, deprecated in favor of 'getThingEntityId'.

methods.name: getThingEntityId
methods.description: Returns the 'ThingId' object representing the entity's identifier.
